outcome: type of bacteria in surgical wounds
cohort: The study included 36 samples from post-cesarean section patients with contaminated surgical wounds who were hospitalized in the Ward Obstetrics and Gynecology RSUD Ulin Banjarmasin.
finding: Three types of bacteria were identified in post-cesarean surgical patient wounds: Staphylococcus aureus (59.3%), Staphylococcus epidermidis (25.0%), and Escherichia coli (15.6%).
